sources.title: Yardlet recovery-tools
sources.locator: Named implementation and associated pinned documentation, independently read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: SessionToolCatalog, SessionToolCenter and AppModel+SessionTools implement typed IDs, scoped reads/messages, child tasks and cross-harness run_agent/wait. Depth3, per-caller floor6 then memory/CPU/thermal admission, 10sec spacing/2sec polling, persisted child queue; ephemeral subagents interrupted on quit with retained results. Per-task token and process ancestry authenticate local socket. Permission ceiling and cross-project approvals apply; 600sec approval deadline, 25min Claude/Codex tool wait or50sec others is not a task runtime cap. Product-owned delegation tools, not merely harness subagent display.

sources.locator: Named implementation and associated pinned documentation, independently read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Stable UUID, title history, state, parent/project and pin/account metadata; Store/SessionRepository.swift archive/unarchive; SessionStore.restore marks interrupted. Native session docs keep provider identity, latest500 transcript entries/read cache, branch/file restore, local index. No separate issue/epic/spec model in inspected Domain/Store, no arbitrary tracker labels or claim API.

sources.title: Yardlet recovery-storage
sources.locator: Named implementation and associated pinned documentation, independently read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Native history/import/fork/restore; cloud list only opens provider pages, no cloud execution. Index and cache under0700 ~/.yardlet. Native task data and structured JSON/SQLite can be copied; no full-task export command found in Views/Store and export/share searches. Task/history search and file-touch index are not semantic code retrieval.

sources.title: Yardlet recovery-restart
sources.locator: Named implementation and associated pinned documentation, independently read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Default-on continuation after quit/update/crash for Claude/Codex/ACP uses provider session and saved record within24h, max4 starting/30sec start window and3 unseen continuations. Questions remain for person. Other harnesses not auto-continued, ephemeral run_agent never resumes. Not exactly-once external actions.

sources.finding: Skills/plugins are provider-reported; Codex skill enable writes provider config and Claude plugin switch writes user settings by explicit command. Installation/removal belongs to harness. Not a Yardlet plugin store or product memory system.

sources.title: Yardlet recovery-review
sources.locator: Named implementation and associated pinned documentation, independently read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: GitHubPullRequestDetail.swift reads checks/review decisions and head SHA, offers merge/rebase/squash/auto-merge via gh. Person confirms, current loaded head passed --match-head-commit when present; no admin bypass. Card refresh can update detail before confirm, so not immutable approval snapshot.20sec gh timeout; failed logs last200lines/64KiB. Re-runs dedupe run IDs. No native review-comment/request-changes composer in inspected PR card path.

sources.title: Yardlet recovery-ci
sources.locator: Named implementation and associated pinned documentation, independently read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Opt-in per task, waits for idle and all checks settled, event key head SHA plus failed names, persists latest20 events, forwards fix/log/push prompt once per retained event. Not test-pass enforcement or unlimited exactly-once ledger; archive/delete removes record.

sources.title: Yardlet recovery-remote
sources.locator: Named implementation and associated pinned documentation, independently read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Paired devices see and drive same host tasks. Host-only grants for terminal/fileWrites/settings/mailCalendar default off; immediate live denial and durable denial fence, removal failure reported. Does not stop messages reaching already privileged agent. Audit records device/task/type/result, not message body; RemoteLimits.swift retains roughly2000 JSONL entries, trims after2500/size threshold. Not immutable or named-human org RBAC. Ordinary one-time approvals remotely, persistent policies/network expansion stay on Mac.

sources.title: Yardlet recovery-load
sources.locator: Named implementation and associated pinned documentation, independently read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Idle offscreen runtimes released after3h, Codex unseen loaded limit10, Claude pressure sweep after60sec idle, no active turns/queued work released. SessionToolPolicy adds resource-aware child admission, not global CPU/RAM cgroups or spend caps.

sources.title: Yardlet recovery-files
sources.locator: Named implementation and associated pinned documentation, independently read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: File mentions use git listing or bounded walk,30kfiles/100kvisits/8MiB listing cap; excludes dependency/build folders. No semantic code index. Remote file preview/output list and browser screenshot tools exist; not an immutable revision evidence package.

sources.title: Yardlet recovery-storetools
sources.locator: Named implementation and associated pinned documentation, independently read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Optional App Store Connect local connector reads builds/reviews, adds build to tester group and submits version for App Review. AppleToolApproval asks for each write. Requires user Apple key/account. Submission by version ID is not whole-code digest approval or general deployment.

sources.title: Yardlet recovery-security
sources.locator: Named implementation and associated pinned documentation, independently read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Private vulnerability reports should receive first reply within a week; one maintainer, only latest release fixed, no guaranteed fix time.

sources.title: Yardlet recovery-privacy
sources.locator: Whole page read 2026-11-25
sources.finding: November25 policy: Yardlet does not train; providers have own terms. Delete local history/Keychain manually; turning usage off removes counts. Optional relay account stores hashed identifiers and device/mac metadata; Cloudflare and Firebase notification path, Google Play variant no login. Hang log under2MB conflicts with pinned README about20MB.
